summary: This 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation Select Notes Trust LT Ser 2003-2 reports a routine distribution to holders of asset-backed certificates. It discloses interest received and per-certificate amounts for the May 15, 2026 distribution date, with no acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation event. The filing is purely a periodic trust reporting event under Item 8.01 (Other Events) for a structured finance vehicle, providing operational update on cash flows to certificateholders, with no strategic corporate action or change in control.
